definitions.dark: a one-photon block whose ideal algebra-mode probability p_algebra is 0: x y = 0, so the photon leaves only through the dilation ports and any algebra-mode detection is implementation error
definitions.bright: a one-photon block with p_algebra = 1: ||x y||^2 = 2, so the photon never reaches a dilation port

preregistered.observable: per job, in_block: the share of one-click samples on the block's modes, and a, the algebra-mode share of those, with the per-mode histogram against the exact ideal

hypotheses.routing: job-00 sends one photon through the identity on 24 modes; in_block below 0.9 on qpu:belenos places the bright block's leakage in the chip's realization of the identity
hypotheses.width: job-01 compiles the bright block as a 4-mode circuit, whose unused chip modes the transpiler sets as mirrors; in_block and a above the 24-mode single/job-04 result by more than 4.5 standard errors attribute the leakage to the 24-mode fit
hypotheses.gate_form: job-02 and job-03 send the exact native BS.H / PS / PERM gates; a computed_circuit equal to the unitary form's, or counts within 4.5 standard errors of job-01 and single/job-04, show that the transpiler re-fits native gates as a unitary
hypotheses.dark_floor: job-04 is the dark block in the best form; its a is the chip's dark floor

preregistered.simulator_stop_rule: on sim:belenos every job reads in_block 1 and its exact ideal within the simulator's g2 floor
